pages: I am writing this on the road. I took the smith's boy's bread from the cell and I took the bell from the chapel wall, the small one, and I walked out of the gate at noon, when they sleep, and nobody stopped me, because nobody thought anyone would want to leave. I am going back to the hill village. I do not know if there is anyone there. If there is, I know how to dig. I will not say where I learned it.
